title: ADHD and autism at risk of over-diagnosis, says government review
description: The review, which focuses on younger age groups, warned there was a risk society was moving from an era of under-diagnosis to over-diagnosis or mis-diagnosis.

title: Polanski failed to show leadership over Zionism motion, ex-Green leader says
description: Caroline Lucas tells the BBC Zack Polanski should have taken part in a vote on a motion declaring Zionism a form of racism.

title: Warrants used to search Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's homes were unlawful, court says
description: A criminal investigation into the former prince continues and police have retained material seized from his homes.

title: Suspect linked to Monaco bomb attack on millionaire breaks silence to BBC
description: Vitalii Zhykovych gives his own account of the attempted assassination of Ukrainian-born businessman Vadym Yermolayev.

title: Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad will be livestreamed, Pentagon says
description: "We'll make sure that people are able to watch it," the US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Thursday.

title: Emotions run high at the round table as Celebrity Traitors banish two players
description: Viewers watched to see whether Richard E Grant could save himself at the first round table of the series.

title: Mark Zuckerberg has an image problem - so why is Meta's business booming?
description: A new film paints the Meta founder as a villain. But the tech firm seems immune to bad publicity, writes our North America tech correspondent.

title: 'Add me to WhatsApp' scam calls to be investigated
description: The UK's data watchdog is investigating a spike in complaints about "robo calls" that appear to lead to a recruitment scam.

title: Two Latvian men arrested on suspicion of trespass at RAF base in Cambridgeshire
description: Police say they apprehended two Latvian men at about 02:00 BST while they were inside the perimeter.
